newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends mixed ahead of PORLA data.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends mixed ahead of PORLA data.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES -Prices ended mixed after drifted uncertainly in late trading ahead of PORLA's Dec data on Wednesday. Trading continued volatile and more selling was seen in Jan. Values eased initially on technical correction after yesterday's gains. March's support 1,290 and resistance 1,320.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Followed the futures and some support was seen among nearby CPOS and selected products.
Third month March futures closed two ringgit lower at 1,298 ($522.96) a tonne after trading between 1,288 and 1,302 ringgit level.
Physical Jan (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,352.50 against bids at 1,345 after trading from 1,345 to 1,350.

Jan (central) was offered at 1,345 and bids at 1,340 with trades of 1,340 and 1,345. Jan (north) was offered at 1,330 and bids at 1,325. Feb (south) saw offers at 1,350 with bids at 1,340 with earlier trades of 1,350, and Feb (central) was offered at 1,340 and bids at 1,335.
Among refined products, Jan RBD palm oil was offered at $567.50 a tonne FOB Malaysia and Feb/March at $565. Feb was traded at $564.
Jan RBD palm olein saw offers at $600, Feb at $600 and March at $592.50. Jan was traded at $600, Feb from $592.50 to $597.50 and March at $587.50 and $590.
Jan RBD palm stearin was offered at $435 and Jan/Feb palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $302.50.
